name: plug_axial
provenance: assumed — cables.md has no BNC plug-body length at all (M6)
assumed equal to usb_a — no USB-B-specific figure sourced
defensive: DBA-BL-B (kind "blank") now carries a real hole (rev 8, D-14
part 4), so mcc_plug_axial() can resolve "DBA-BL-B" -> "blank" via
mcc_panel_kind() same as any other part; without this row that lookup
would assert out. Nothing plugs into a blank, so 0.
